title: At the bar with a friend
goal: Order a drink and a snack, ask your friend what they want, and pay at the end.
role: Your friend Luca, who is meeting you at a café in Bologna. Relaxed and friendly; uses tu.
opening: Ciao! Finalmente! Allora, cosa prendi? Io ho una fame...
openingEn: Hi! At last! So, what are you having? I'm starving...
focus: tu forms (prendi, vuoi) and ordering with 'vorrei' / 'prendo'

title: Asking a stranger for directions
goal: Politely ask how to get to the train station and whether it is far.
role: A passer-by in their sixties in the centre of Florence. Polite; uses Lei and expects Lei.
focus: Lei forms: scusi, sa, può; dov'è; vicino / lontano

title: Checking into a hotel
goal: Check in: give your name, confirm how many nights you are staying, and ask what time breakfast is.
role: The receptionist at Hotel Bellavista in Rome. Professional; uses Lei.
opening: Buonasera, benvenuto all'Hotel Bellavista. Ha una prenotazione?
openingEn: Good evening, welcome to Hotel Bellavista. Do you have a reservation?
focus: Lei; numbers and times; camera, notte, colazione

title: Talking about your weekend
goal: Tell your friend at least three things you did last weekend, then ask about theirs.
role: Your Italian friend Chiara, chatting on Monday morning. Curious; asks follow-up questions; uses tu.
opening: Ciao! Com'è andato il fine settimana? Cosa hai fatto?
openingEn: Hi! How was the weekend? What did you do?
focus: passato prossimo: essere vs avere, participle agreement

title: When you were little
goal: Describe where you lived as a child and what you used to do, and ask about your friend's childhood.
role: Marta, a new friend in your language exchange group. Warm; uses tu.
opening: Io sono cresciuta in un paese vicino al mare. E tu, dove abitavi da piccolo?
openingEn: I grew up in a village by the sea. And you, where did you live as a kid?

title: At a trattoria
goal: Order something to drink, a first and a second course, then ask for the bill.
role: A waiter in a family-run trattoria. Friendly but professional; uses Lei.
opening: Buonasera! Ecco il menù. Cosa desidera da bere?
openingEn: Good evening! Here's the menu. What would you like to drink?
focus: Lei; vorrei; per favore; il conto

title: Free practice
goal: Chat about anything: yourself, your day, your plans. Keep sentences short and simple.
role: A friendly Italian conversation partner who keeps things simple; uses tu.
opening: Ciao! Di cosa vuoi parlare oggi?
openingEn: Hi! What would you like to talk about today?
